meta.name: antinet-security-scan
meta.description: 信息安全分析师与软件开发工程师在搭建文档处理流水线时，当需要拦截违规文件或外部URL，请挂载此技能作为强制前置安检，自动输出 pass/reject 判定与详细合规扫描报告，一键守住零信任安全底线。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动拦截文档流水线中的违规文件与外部URL，输出合规扫描报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在搭建文档处理流水线，需要拦截违规文件或外部URL以保障安全。
copy.tagline_en: Block bad files and URLs in document pipelines and output compliance reports.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build document pipelines and need to block bad files or URLs for security.

howto.what: 装上后，当文件或外部 URL 进入文档处理流水线前，Claude 会先做安全合规扫描，输出 pass / reject 判定与扫描报告，并生成 trace_id 留痕。
howto.when: 由锦衣卫 Worker 在收到文件或 URL 时调用，作为流水线第一道闸门；任何文件进入系统前都必须经它把关。

say.text: 查这个 URL 是否命中违规域名黑名单
say.note: 报告黑名单命中项与风险等级

say.text: 换一套 policy_ref 规则重扫这份文件
say.note: 按你指定的合规规则集重新判定

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude scans a local file or external URL before it enters your document pipeline, returns a pass or reject verdict with a scan report, and logs a trace_id.
howto.when_en: Called by the Jinyiwei worker when it receives a file or URL, acting as the pipeline's first gate; every file must pass it before entering the system.

say_en.text: Scan /tmp/contract.pdf and tell me pass or reject
Check if this URL is on the banned-domain blacklist
say_en.note: Reports blacklist hits and risk level

say_en.text: Re-scan this file with a different policy_ref rule set
